description.value:
Forged with a rare silver alloy, this +2 resilient standard-grade silver @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Full Plate] bears protective inscriptions that strengthen the wearer's resolve and draw the attention of enemies. While wearing the armor, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion or possession effects.

Activate—Face Me 2 (emotion, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You challenge an enemy, attracting its wrath. Choose an enemy within 30 feet that can see you; it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:31] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] damage and takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

Failure As success, but the target takes @Damage[6d8[mental]] damage, and the penalty lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As success, but the target takes @Damage[12d8[mental]] damage, and the penalty lasts for 1 minute. In addition, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1} and can't reduce its frightened value below 1 for the duration of the penalty.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
